title: One-pan garlic butter pasta in 40 seconds

scenes.narration: Salted water, rolling boil. Pasta goes in for eight minutes.
scenes.visual: Overhead close-up of hands dropping dried spaghetti into a pot of vigorously boiling salted water on a stovetop, steam rising, bright kitchen light, fast-cut cooking video style, vertical video

scenes.narration: Meanwhile: six cloves of garlic, sliced thin. Do not rush this.
scenes.visual: Overhead macro shot of hands thinly slicing fresh garlic cloves on a wooden cutting board with a chef's knife, precise fast cuts, bright kitchen light, vertical video

scenes.narration: Half a stick of butter in a cold pan. Medium-low heat.
scenes.visual: Close-up of hands placing a pat of butter into a stainless steel pan, butter beginning to melt and foam as the pan heats, bright kitchen light, vertical video

scenes.narration: Garlic in. Stir until golden, not brown. Brown means bitter.
scenes.visual: Close-up of sliced garlic sizzling in foaming melted butter in a steel pan, a wooden spoon stirring gently, garlic turning pale gold, steam, vertical video

scenes.narration: Pasta straight from the pot into the pan. Splash of pasta water.
scenes.visual: Close-up of tongs transferring glossy cooked spaghetti from pot into the garlic butter pan, a ladle adding a splash of starchy pasta water, steam rising, vertical video

scenes.narration: Toss hard. The starch and butter emulsify into a silky sauce.
scenes.visual: Close-up of hands tossing spaghetti in the pan with quick flipping motions, glossy sauce coating the strands, steam and motion, bright kitchen light, vertical video

scenes.narration: Off heat. Handful of parmesan, black pepper, torn parsley.
scenes.visual: Overhead close-up of hands grating parmesan over the pasta in the pan, cracking black pepper, sprinkling torn parsley leaves, vertical video

scenes.narration: Twirl, plate, done. Eight ingredients, one pan, zero excuses.
scenes.visual: Close-up of a large fork and ladle twirling a neat nest of glossy garlic butter spaghetti onto a warm ceramic plate, final beauty shot with parsley garnish, vertical video
